description: Live per-shop prices for ONE product: every shop in its market that has the identical configuration in stock, cheapest first, with links to the shop's own product page. Takes a product id or a lebtechlb.com / priceteq.com product or laptop URL.

market.description: Optional market: LB (Lebanon, default), AE (UAE), SA (Saudi Arabia), QA (Qatar), JO (Jordan), OM (Oman), EG (Egypt), KW (Kuwait) or BH (Bahrain). Prices come back in that market's currency. A priceteq.com URL sets it by itself.

product.description: A product id, or a lebtechlb.com /product/ or /laptop/ URL, or a priceteq.com /<market>/product/ URL.

name: get_product_prices
title: Prices for one product
